nodes.label: Compare the options
nodes.description: Lay the candidates against the constraints. Include what each one costs, not only what it offers.

config.outputSpec: a comparison against the stated constraints

nodes.label: Sharpen the question
nodes.description: Restate the question so that an answer would be recognisably right or wrong, and state the constraints that matter.

config.outputSpec: the problem and the constraints that bind it

nodes.label: Recommend
nodes.description: One recommendation, the reason, what would change it, and what remains uncertain.

config.outputSpec: a recommendation with its cost, its consequences and what would change it

nodes.label: Gather sources
nodes.description: Prefer primary sources: official documentation, the source itself, release notes. Record where each claim came from.

config.outputSpec: sources with what each one supports

nodes.label: Check the claims
nodes.description: Confirm the load-bearing claims against a source or a small experiment. Mark anything you could not confirm.
